effects.title: Point · Effects
effects.scope: Iterations, lighting, material and image sources for this point

descs.palette: Strength of this point's base color in the gradient
descs.iridescencePower: Intensity of the optional spectral tint
descs.zebra: Adds discrete iteration bands around this point
descs.tessellation: Blends the selected image texture into this point
descs.shading: Blends the relief lighting with the point's color
descs.skybox: Adds the environment reflection to the material response
descs.webcam: Blends the camera feed when webcam mode is available
descs.smoothness: Uses continuous iterations rather than stepped ones
descs.stripeAverage: Folds striped orbit data into the color
descs.rotationMean: Uses orbit direction coherence as a signal
descs.stripeReliefTilt: Turns the stripes into local relief
descs.shadingLevel: Direct light intensity for this point
descs.specularPower: Direct specular highlight intensity; zero disables it
descs.dielectricSpecular: Neutral reflectance at normal incidence (F0) for stone, glass, ceramic or plastic; no metallic colored effect
descs.metallic: How much this point behaves like a metal
descs.roughness: Controls highlight sharpness: low = fine and crisp, high = broad and diffuse
descs.anisotropy: Stretches highlights and orients the iridescence along the surface direction
descs.reliefGain: Multiplies the analytic relief for this material; 1 is neutral, independent of the global Relief depth
descs.protrusion: Accentuates the relief near smoothed iteration crossings; 0 is neutral
descs.metalReflectance: Multiplies the metal reflectance without directly changing its tint
descs.metalEnvironmentTint: Blends between the legacy perceptual metal response (0) and a linear, colored, roughness-compensated physical response (1)
descs.diffraction: Holographic grating engraved along the iteration bands: a rainbow that turns with the light
descs.cloisonne: Raised gold wires on band and external-ray boundaries, glossy enamel inside the cells
descs.cloisonneRays: Number of external rays splitting the cells (2^n); 0 = rings only
descs.translucency: Light passes through the thin matter near the set (jade, wax), shadow side included
